id.description: Stable slug: q-<speaker>-<work>-<first 8 of quote_sha256>. Regenerating the corpus from unchanged inputs reproduces the same id.

quote.description: VERBATIM. Never paraphrased, never cleaned up. Internal punctuation, spelling and marked ellipses preserved as printed.

role.description: author = their own words in their own text; reported = their speech as rendered by someone else; institution = a company, lab or paper speaking corporately.

work.description: The work cited, as a traditional citation gives it. Where the words were taken from another work, that work is named in the traditional form: “quoted in …”.

locus.description: page, section or paragraph, as the printing gives it

file.description: Repo-relative path of a copy of the work held in the collection.

url.description: Public URL of a copy of the work.

restored.description: The words an ellipsis or an unmarked cut removed, verbatim. Empty when nothing was cut or the cut words are not held. Never commentary.

years.description: Every four-digit year in the `date` field, and ONLY that field. The `work` field is deliberately excluded because it carries publication, translation and revision years for the printing a passage was read in, which are not the year the thing was said: a 1956 letter read in a 2006 revision of a 1993 translation is a 1956 quotation. A record may carry more than one year when the date itself names more than one — an address and its later printing, say — and matches a range filter if any of them falls inside it.

collections.description: which extraction pass produced it; a record found by more than one pass carries both

quote_sha256.description: sha256 of the whitespace-normalised quote. Dedupe and integrity key.

embed_text.description: Concatenation built for vectorisation: speaker | work | locus | date | quote | restored. Regenerate if any component changes.
